free_tier.stated: Datum Storage gives you one free terabyte of space for the first year; paid additional storage is listed as Coming Soon at US$3.99 per terabyte per month.

per_object_cap.notes: No object-size limit is stated on the home or get-started pages; the S3-compatible endpoint is documented without a size clause.

retention.notes: The home page states a free terabyte for the first year and US$3.99 per terabyte per month; no data-retention term is stated.

egress.terms: unverified: no egress charge or allowance is stated on the home or get-started pages

tooling: S3 API only ('designed to be compatible with the Amazon S3 API format'); tested clients Arq Backup, Duplicati/Duplicity/Duplicacy untested
chaining: 1 TB x N identities, but each identity needs a phone-verified Datum ID, so identity cost is the multiplier
limits_note: 1 TB/account; requires the Datum ID mobile app on iOS/Android as the identity provider. There is no web-only path.
reliability_note: app-gated identity makes account automation awkward; the product markets itself as early-stage ('not all [S3 clients] have been tested')
